observations: Two photos show a full-size electronic keyboard/piano-style instrument still wrapped in plastic/packaging.
Visible white and black keys; control panel with buttons/knobs and a small display area is present but not clearly readable.
No clear brand/model name is readable from the photos; only a watermark text appears on the image (not the product).
The seller’s text says “London used keyboard”, but the photos do not clearly confirm “London” as a brand/model.

claims.claim: Quality London used keyboard with super sounds
claims.evidence: Photos show a keyboard wrapped in plastic; brand/model and audio/sound quality cannot be verified from the images.

risks.risk: Brand/model and exact specifications are not readable, so the correct market comparable and feature set are unknown.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the brand/model label (usually on the back/bottom) and the control panel text.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used electronic keyboard with unknown features (worst-case: basic/entry-level).

risks.risk: Functionality is unknown (keys, speakers, power, and ports may be faulty). Plastic wrapping prevents inspection.
risks.proof: A short video clip showing power-on and playing several keys, plus a quick test of volume/speakers and any headphone/USB/MIDI ports if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / potentially not working until proven.

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (power adapter, sustain pedal, stand, manual) are unknown.
risks.proof: Photos of everything included: power adapter/charger, sustain pedal, stand (if any), and any cables/manual.
risks.if_unproven: Price as keyboard only (no accessories included).

risks.risk: Physical condition issues (scratches, broken keys, dead buttons) cannot be confirmed through the plastic wrap.
risks.proof: Unwrap and take close-up photos of the keybed, corners, and the control panel; include a photo of any damage indicators.
risks.if_unproven: Price as having possible cosmetic wear (worst-case: noticeable wear).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the brand/model label (back or bottom) and any sticker with model number.
Video: power-on + playing keys (showing sound), volume up/down, and speaker/headphone output if available.
Photos of included accessories (power adapter/charger, sustain pedal, stand, cables/manual).
Unwrapped close-ups of the keys and control panel to confirm no broken/dead parts.
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a keyboard, but the brand/model and working condition (sound) are not verifiable remotely because it’s wrapped and labels aren’t readable. Without that, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
